description: Get the short style card and the full edit prompt for the Switch Style codes you pick (for example "O10 W1 F4 B6 A2 G4", or your own learned style such as "Y1"), or a 4 to 6 code suggestion for the feeling you describe for your video. Show the card and wait for a yes before editing, then follow the prompt with the editor tools. Free, read-only.

codes.description: The codes in any form, for example "O10 W1 F4".

feeling.description: When there are no codes: what the edit should feel like, or what the video is about.

why.description: One short line on why this mix fits, shown at the end of the card.

name: apply_style
title: Apply Switch Styles
